course.about: Ace of Trades is a Nasdaq-futures-focused trading mentorship founded by Akram Ace, centred on a specific framework for reading price action. Members get daily charting sessions, weekly trading-psychology lectures and Q&A, daily trade reviews, and 1:1 message support from a 3-person coaching team, through a Discord-based community.

course.testimonials_note: These are customer reviews for Ace of Trades on Whop, republished by an independent, unofficial affiliate site (not Akram Ace's own site) since the official site is a single-page app that didn't return readable content to us, and Whop's own review pages are JS-rendered. We haven't independently re-verified them, and we don't verify trading performance or results.

_notes.source: IMPORTANT: guessed Whop profile handles (@aceoftrades, @ace-of-trades) returned unrelated/empty accounts — neither is the real seller. The real official site, joinaceoftrades.com, is a client-rendered single-page app that only returned its title tag to every fetch attempt (root, /pricing, /faq all tried). Descriptive content (formats, curriculum, testimonials) came from getaceoftrades.net, an independent, unofficial affiliate review site — confirmed unofficial because its own join link uses a different affiliate ID ("eoggier") than ours, and it shares the exact page structure (/review, /worthit, /pricing, /faq, /alternatives) of another unofficial site we'd already flagged for Stocks with Josh, suggesting the same third-party operator runs both. Pricing/rating/commission independently confirmed via whoptrends.com and cross-checked against the unofficial site's own FAQ (both agree: $150/month, 4.9/5, 176 reviews); 30% affiliate commission per whoptrends.com. No Trustpilot profile found for either domain. No refund policy could be confirmed from a source we trust. Logo pulled from joinaceoftrades.com's own favicon.
